title: Saxophonist Al Wilson and Cormick Scott
summary: Reason confirms Al Wilson played with Nellie Lutcher and names another player from Texas.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: And did you know a saxophone player named Al? He used to play around with Paul and Nellie and something like that.
Wait a minute. Al Wilson. Mm-hmm.
Yeah, I know Al Wilson. Oh, yeah. Yeah. He played all that. In fact, Al Wilson was with us with Nellie Latchett.
We had another boy named Cormick Scott. We got him out of Texas.
And you mentioned him with the Nighthawks, too. Cormick Scott. Was he with the Nighthawks? No. No, he wasn't with the Nighthawks. I got it. No.
